name: yipyap-language
description: Provider-neutral Yip-Yap language learning with supported-host session bootstrap and a bounded account connector.

interface.longDescription: Public read-first release with supported-host fresh-session bootstrap and one shared language Skill. Its bounded connector reads verified account settings and teaching context; missing or unverified state fails closed to L0.
defaultPrompt: Use $yipyap-language to show my current Yip-Yap setup status.
Use $yipyap-language to explain how Yip-Yap language levels work.
Use $yipyap-language to check whether Yip-Yap language is connected.
